page_title: BOL 0-1 PAR | Bologna v Parma 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' The resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) comes to nothing.

90+8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) unleashes a close-range volley towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
90+7' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends the corner into the box, but Edoardo Corvi intercepts it and averts the threat.

90+5' 0 - 1 Hans Nicolussi Caviglia slides a pass towards Christian Ordonez (Parma) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:1.
90+3' Santiago Castro (Bologna) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Juan Miranda, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar.
90+3' Here's the latest number of offsides – 3:4. The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:5.
90+2' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma). Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Edoardo Corvi comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
89' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wasted a clear opportunity. He fired a first-time shot from point-blank range, but it rattled the left post!
88' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
87' Substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jonathan Rowe walks off.
87' That will be all from Federico Bernardeschi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
87' Here is a change. Mandela Keita is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma).
86' Substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is replaced by Franco Carboni (Parma).
84' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Edoardo Corvi comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' The total number of attempts is 10:5. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
83' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
82' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post.
79' Mariano Troilo (Parma) sees a yellow card in the hand of Giuseppe Collu. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Mariano Troilo (Parma) is sent from the pitch.
79' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Ordonez (Parma) replacing Oliver Sorensen.
77' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
76' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
76' Half-chance! Juan Miranda (Bologna) plays a pass into the box, but Edoardo Corvi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
76' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
76' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

76' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Parma due to an offside in the build-up play.
71' The Parma players halt their celebrations as referee Giuseppe Collu makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
69' OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Santiago Castro (Bologna) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 0:1.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) brings his opponent down. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
68' Juan Miranda comes onto the pitch because Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
66' Santiago Castro almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Mandela Keita (Parma) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
61' Mariano Troilo (Parma) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
60' The game is interrupted as Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is flagged offside.
60' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
59' A clumsy foul by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bologna.
58' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is adjudged offside.
57' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Thijs Dallinga and he is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
56' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
56' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Skorupski, who smothers the ball.
55' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' The substitution has been made. Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) has replaced Gaetano Oristanio.
54' The game is interrupted now, Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
52' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
50' The corner from Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is cleared away by the defence.
49' The game is interrupted. Sascha Britschgi (Parma) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
47' The ball ricochets out to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) and he blasts a first-time shot towards goal from inside the box, but the effort flies high over the bar.
46' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' It's time for a substitution. Nadir Zortea (Bologna) comes on in place of Joao Mario.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45+4' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
45+3' Mandela Keita (Parma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sent a pass onto Mateo Pellegrino, who didn't get a chance to finish.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Enrico Delprato (Parma) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
40' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
37' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
37' Joao Mario (Bologna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
33' Mariano Troilo (Parma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
32' A cross into the box finds the head of Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) who steers it goalwards, but Edoardo Corvi manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
31' 3:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:0.
28' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

27' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
26' A pass into the penalty area from Oliver Sorensen (Parma) is intercepted by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Parma.
23' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
22' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Tommaso Pobega (Bologna). He’s got to go!

19' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna), but referee Giuseppe Collu must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
19' Mandela Keita (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
18' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Giuseppe Collu signals a foul. Parma earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
16' 63:37 – the ratio of ball possession.
15' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
14' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Oliver Sorensen (Parma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
12' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Remo Freuler (Bologna) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
10' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
8' Wasted effort! Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
7' Enrico Delprato (Parma) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
6' Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joao Mario (Bologna). A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
5' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
4' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle after Mariano Troilo (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Bologna win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
4' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
2' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
2' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) sends a long ball forward to Federico Bernardeschi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Giuseppe Collu was nominated as the referee for this game.
